title: SystemFacts
description: Layer 1 of the taxonomy: detected, read-only facts about the machine. Produced at boot and re-produced on device events (display change, HMD connect/disconnect, driver update, power source change). Capabilities (layer 2) are derived from these by the rules engine; the v2 config's is_*_available / can_use_* flags become outputs of that derivation. See docs/01-taxonomy-and-rules.md.

arch.description: e.g. Blackwell, Ada, RDNA4, RDNA2, Xe2

vrr.description: G-SYNC / FreeSync / Adaptive-Sync capable and enabled in the driver

hdr.description: HDR-capable and HDR enabled in Windows

tripleSurface.description: native = engine drives 3 outputs (child windows); spanned = NVIDIA Surround / AMD Eyefinity single surface

runtime.description: Active OpenXR runtime, e.g. SteamVR, Meta (Oculus), Virtual Desktop, Pimax

perEyeWidth.description: Runtime-recommended per-eye width at 100% pixel density

ccds.description: AMD chiplet count; 2 = dual-CCD (cross-CCD latency matters)

x3dCcd.description: Index of the CCD with 3D V-Cache, if any

gameThreadsOnCacheCcd.description: Whether the game's main threads are currently scheduled on the V-Cache CCD (from affinity sampling)

hags.description: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling. Required for DLSS Frame Generation.

autoHdr.description: Windows Auto HDR applies to this title

vrrGlobal.description: Windows 'Variable refresh rate' toggle (affects DX11/legacy paths)

windowedOptimizations.description: 'Optimizations for windowed games': flip-model presentation for borderless

chipsetDriverCoreParking.description: AMD 3D V-Cache Performance Optimizer / core-parking service active (dual-CCD X3D)

sdk.description: Feature support as reported by the engine's SDK queries (Streamline slIsFeatureSupported, FidelityFX, XeSS). This is hardware/driver capability only; OS gates such as HAGS are evaluated separately so the UI can tell 'impossible' (R1) apart from 'fixable' (R2).

telemetry.description: Baseline performance samples used for estimates and the health panel. In the mockups these values are simulated.

gpuMsPerMP.description: GPU ms per rendered megapixel at the 'High' quality reference

cpuMs.description: CPU frame time at the 'High' reference (view distance High, 10 cars ahead)

baseVramGB.description: VRAM used before textures and render targets

configOverrides.description: Mockup-only: v2 config paths that differ for this rig's saved config (e.g. display.is_triple).

maxMultiplier.description: Frame generation only: highest multiplier the hardware/driver supports
